title: Some confirmed-values tests have weak controls: they should fail if the value were never confirmed, not only because nothing renders
evidence: Root fix R31: every US-03 AC6 check now confirms the value in the same test and asserts it then drives the plan, the chat or the event. HealthTool.journey.test.tsx gained the control in 'half a blood pressure in the vitals grid drives nothing', 'half a blood pressure in the vitals matrix drives nothing', 'a draft value leaves the plan to the record', 'a blood-test draft restored as the page loads', 'a vitals draft restored as the page loads' and 'across a remote change, a draft typed on this page stays on screen'; the other AC6 checks there, the onboarding-pins 'typed, not saved' and 'in the grid, unconfirmed' checks and HealthTool.lab-egfr.test.tsx already commit and assert. Each file fails with the grid's save (BloodTestTimeline handleSave, StartingInfoVitals commit) stubbed out.
